payload.reason: The evidence provides specific methods and protocols for evaluating segmentation quality, including comparisons with manually annotated references and performance metrics such as F-score and recall.

claims.text: Segmentation quality is evaluated by comparing automatic segmentations with manually annotated references, such as the Annodis corpus.
An evaluation protocol was established to measure the performance of segmenters, focusing on metrics like F-score and recall.
The evaluation includes measuring the distance between human markers and comparing expert and naive segmentations.
